essence: The ritual implement must be made thirty-six fingers long and eight fingers wide.
In both width and length the implement should resemble the face of a boar.
The ear of the implement must be two measures long and four fingers wide.
The part may measure three or four measures and must have a hole in its middle.
The implement should be made four fingers by increasing in increments of a quarter finger.
